texts.title: The Canvass
texts.body: {self.name}'s name is down for the election, and now it must be carried round: to the houses, to the benches, to the men who are owed and the men who owe. A candidate who does not ask is assumed not to want it.

choices.spend_a_little: Spend a little where it will be remembered.

texts.title: The Count Goes Your Way
texts.body: The tellers have finished. {self.name} is elected, and for five years will hold an office of the Reach in {self.name}'s own name and not the house's. It is one rung. There are others above it, and people already asking which {self.name} will want next.

texts.title: The Count Goes Against You
texts.body: The tellers have finished, and it is not {self.name}. The houses were asked and chose someone else. There will be another election in five years, and {self.name} will be five years older at it.

choices.learn_who_did_not_vote: Learn who did not vote as they promised.
choices.say_you_never_wanted_it: Say you never much wanted it.

texts.title: One Of Yours Is Elected
texts.body: {kin.name} stood, on {kin.name}'s own decision, and the houses have chosen {kin.name}. For five years one of {self.name}'s own will sit as a magistrate of the Reach. {kin.name} did the asking, and {kin.name} won it.

choices.remind_them_whose_name_they_carry: Remind them whose name they carry.

texts.title: The Aedile's Games
texts.body: The city expects games of its aediles, and remembers for a generation which were good. {self.name} has the office, the season is coming, and the contractors are waiting to hear what kind of games these are to be.

choices.something_the_city_has_not_seen: Something the city has not seen.
choices.spend_it_on_the_drains: Spend it on the drains instead.
